tasks.description: Record one internal, idempotent account deletion request and retire the active owner state for later purge integration.
constraints: Internal local SQL precursor only. Return valid Git unified patch with exact context in JSON. Controller applies and verifies. No HTTP route or grants for the writer to service_role in this packet. No app, staging, real owner actions, Auth/Storage deletion, token revocation, billing, workers, schedules or table-policy changes.

After locking an existing permanent owner with the normal profile lock, public.request_account_deletion_internal(p_owner_id uuid,p_operation_id uuid) should create one private queue intent and exact owner-scoped operation_receipts response for account.delete, and flip only that owner's authoritative account_state to deleting at the canonical monotonic watermark in one transaction. Minimal queue schema with one record per owner and enough identity/timestamp for later worker; no personal data or speculative purge phases. Enable RLS and deny ordinary direct access. An exact same-owner replay remains valid in deleting state; reject foreign/same-operation-other-command, nonexistent, anonymous and nonreplay inactive owners without disclosure or changes. Do not let auth profile sync revive the deleting owner. No deletion or mutation of old catalogue, journals, quota and purchases.

Use a version-compatible, scoped pgTAP addition to the already gate-covered auth_registration_profile.test.sql demonstrating one intent/receipt, disabling active service read paths, auth trigger irreversibility, exact retry, absence of cross-owner effects and preservation of fixture history. Explicitly characterize this as internal only; direct authenticated table-access protection, workers and auth revocation must be reviewed before exposing a product route. T082/T083 remain open.

acceptance_criteria.description: Diff limited to internal SQL and covered fixture.
PostgreSQL clean and upgrade exercise the owner state and exact local request semantics.
